200.description: The API is ready: its database answers.

503.description: The API is not ready: its database did not answer, or the probe itself failed.

get.description: Check that the API is ready: it reaches the database with a SELECT 1, answers 200 while the database answers and 503 as soon as it does not. No authentication, so an uptime monitor can poll it every minute.

version.description: The commit the running build was made from, or null outside a deployed build.

database.description: Whether the database answered a SELECT 1.

payments.description: Whether a payment provider key is configured. No call is made to the provider, and this check never makes the API unavailable.

HealthUnavailable.description: The API is not ready: its database did not answer, or the probe itself failed.

version.description: The commit the running build was made from, or null outside a deployed build.

database.description: Whether the database answered a SELECT 1.

payments.description: Whether a payment provider key is configured. No call is made to the provider, and this check never makes the API unavailable.

HealthReady.description: The API is ready: its database answers.
